scope: All missing or canonically diverged native OS and user-program paths, excluding third-party bootloader/libc trees

dispositions.rationale: Canonical code owns CPU-local process roots, entry stacks, bounded boot data, AP readiness and precise user-copy recovery; donor variants rely on older global-root or lifecycle assumptions.
dispositions.validation: BIOS/UEFI x 1/4 CPU, concurrent CPL3/syscalls/IRQs, malformed boot data, process isolation, remote revocation and nested-entry review.

dispositions.rationale: The files expose unsupported VBS, eBPF, IOMMU and attestation surfaces without a trustworthy backend, ownership model or synchronized registration.
dispositions.validation: Reconsider only with a real backend, authenticated immutable selection, failure cleanup and platform-specific CI.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical TEE, TPM and core-cookie modules replace the donor's mixed real/no-op paths; a duplicate HAL could report software behavior as hardware-backed.
dispositions.validation: Real TDX/TPM quote and PCR validation plus SMT sibling-exclusion tests remain release gates.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical boot preserves Multiboot2 magic, uses the bounded parser, orders current mitigation/KPTI initialization and removes destructive production diagnostics.
dispositions.validation: Clean BIOS/UEFI x 1/4 CPU, wrong-magic and malformed-tag negatives, production disk sentinel and setup wizard.

dispositions.rationale: The donor's early-refusal semantics were reimplemented through bounded canonical CPU detection. The canonical gate now covers every facility used unconditionally by the bootstrap and kernel, preserves the admitted snapshot and avoids pre-IDT MSR access.
dispositions.validation: Host matrix 4/4, production ELF and EFI compile, canonical Limine BIOS/UEFI boot at 1/4 CPUs, and twelve Multiboot2 QEMU feature-mask refusals passed. Direct EFI negative execution and a heterogeneous AP refusal remain open; see docs/design/evidence/baremetal-preflight-2026-09-18/.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical CPU detection was split so early feature collection performs bounded CPUID only, while the validated snapshot is later enriched with microcode data without being replaced.
dispositions.validation: Production build and snapshot-order tests passed. Direct EFI negative execution and heterogeneous-AP runtime validation remain open.

dispositions.rationale: The CPU API now separates bounded feature collection from the later microcode MSR read so early boot cannot fault on an MSR before exception handling exists.
dispositions.validation: Production build, source-order test and independent security review passed; runtime limits match the paired preflight implementation.

dispositions.rationale: The standalone EFI entry now checks the same mandatory CPU contract before constructing NX mappings or writing EFER and PAT.
dispositions.validation: The EFI object compiles and mask/order review passed. The current standalone vos3.efi artifact is rejected by OVMF before its banner, so direct-EFI runtime validation remains open.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical code adds retained AI-context readers, transactional PMM/VMA work, effective permission checks, per-process roots and generation-bound TLB acknowledgements.
dispositions.validation: Concurrent context lifetime, PMM failure injection, COW/VMA transitions, cross-process isolation and remote TLB revocation.

dispositions.rationale: The donor predicate was replaced by a canonical reservation ledger with checked arithmetic and replay-resistant handles. Heavy monitor work was moved out of timer IRQ context, and ai_slots now fully scrubs KV pages. Integration into the real guard and KV allocation lifecycles remains open.
dispositions.validation: The primitive passes sanitizer, optimized, release and contract checks; source and build gates prove monitor deferral. Still required: retained region handles, cancellation-safe rollback/reclaim, generation-safe slot teardown, PMM/VMM fault injection and 1/2/4-vCPU runtime evidence.

dispositions.rationale: The donor explicitly lacks production callers and has no ASID allocator, reuse generation, remote invalidation or lifetime protocol; no-flush reuse could expose stale translations.
dispositions.validation: Any future PCID implementation needs ASID exhaustion/reuse, destroy/page reuse, SMP shootdown, global mapping, errata and non-PCID fallback tests.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical scheduling owns CPU-local entry state, safe deferred reaping, immutable identities and lost-wakeup/cancellation repairs.
dispositions.validation: Concurrent AP workloads, blocking/preempted syscalls, synchronization destroy/cancel races and task/SHM/AI teardown.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical code retains NX copy aliases, transactional exec state, FD/address-space ownership, safe fork publication and explicit diagnostic-build routing.
dispositions.validation: Malformed ELF and W^X matrix, injected exec/fork failures, signal/FD lifecycle and release build-config checks.

dispositions.rationale: VOS3-Cyber uniquely identifies partial brk-growth rollback and clone TID-pointer validation, but its rollback can unmap pre-existing holes and its clone-time range check does not prevent exit-time TOCTOU. The canonical clone path now clears inherited clear_child_tid before publication, rejects unsupported CHILD_SETTID, checks PARENT_SETTID usercopy, and uses the shared atomic TID allocator. Exit and fault-exit consume clear_child_tid once without directly dereferencing user memory. brk remains open: safe repair requires an address-space ownership transaction spanning demand faults, mmap, SHM and fallible SMP TLB shootdown; two reviewed prototypes were rejected rather than merged.
dispositions.validation: Clone/TID host extraction test plus kernel build pass; native pthread/fault/SMP tests remain required. For brk, first add atomic no-replace fault claim/commit and common address reservations, then inject failure/races on every page/gap and TLB_BUSY, verify exact rollback, overflow/user-end and shrink beyond 4096 resident pages.

dispositions.rationale: The checked-in blob is stale; the active build generates build/generated/embedded_bins.c from user/programs.mk.
dispositions.validation: Assert the normal build never consumes the tracked blob and generated entries/hashes equal current program ELFs.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical code owns retained FD-table cloning and the versioned, bounded SYSINFO ABI; donor syscall 99 can overwrite smaller callers.
dispositions.validation: Concurrent clone/close/ref failures plus SYSINFO canary, cross-page, read-only and musl ENOSYS tests.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical IPC adds generational handles, immutable owner identity, operation pins, address-space-owned mappings and task-owned signal state.
dispositions.validation: Stale-handle reuse, blocked-waiter destroy, creator/mapper exit orders, fork/clone/exec signals, forged frames and SMP races.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical programs use the versioned telemetry ABI, checked process/SHM cleanup, current fork restrictions and complete build dependency tracking.
dispositions.validation: Clean/no-op/config-change builds, exact program inventory, injected fork/map/wait/telemetry failures and full native program ordering/status.

dispositions.rationale: Donors hard-code an unowned physical address, fall back to ordinary RAM MOVNTDQ and report NPU/WC success without a device. Canonical denial/unavailable behavior is honest.
dispositions.validation: Keep denial tests; a future positive path requires enumerated BAR ownership, IOMMU policy and a real device or explicit device fixture without fallback scoring.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical build isolates outputs, tracks configuration, loads at 32 MiB for firmware compatibility and fails closed through the current ISO runner.
dispositions.validation: Clean/no-op/flag-change builds, parallel build directories, section/W^X map, BIOS/UEFI and missing-tool failure.

dispositions.rationale: Headers match the selected CPU-local roots, lifetime ownership, exact uaccess, versioned ABI and synchronization implementations.
dispositions.validation: Compile and runtime gates for the paired implementations; restore missing SPDX metadata separately without rolling back code.

dispositions.rationale: These interfaces promise NPU, AHCI, CR4 pinning, attestation or Hyper-V behavior that their paired donor implementations do not enforce.
dispositions.validation: Add APIs only with a real implementation, fail-closed feature detection, cleanup and target hardware tests.

dispositions.rationale: The internal contract is implemented with explicit failure codes for the twelve mandatory facilities and a bounded optional-feature result. It remains an internal kernel ABI while runtime coverage is completed.
dispositions.validation: Compile and evaluator coverage passed; a drift test enforces identical bootstrap masks. Direct EFI and heterogeneous-AP negative runtime validation remain open.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical MMR audit, architecture ECAM, safe PCID-0 KPTI and per-CPU silicon hardening replace these older contracts.
dispositions.validation: Qualify the canonical replacements; do not restore duplicate ABIs.

dispositions.rationale: The donor has no periodic verification, does not mediate all CR4 writes and stores global rather than per-CPU state.
dispositions.validation: A replacement needs a per-CPU model, one audited CR4 write API and tamper tests on every CPU.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical per-CPU silicon hardening and conditional SMAP usercopy replace the old helper, which can execute STAC/CLAC on unsupported CPUs.
dispositions.validation: Test SMEP/SMAP present and absent on BSP/AP, plus usercopy fault recovery.

dispositions.rationale: The donor uses a weak TPM no-op, allocates under a spinlock and can leave partial appends; canonical sec/mmr_audit is the selected implementation.
dispositions.validation: Canonical MMR still needs known vectors, synchronized parallel append/finalize and PCR checks before release.

dispositions.rationale: Canonical code preserves wide APIC IDs, SMP/IRQ-safe I/O, disables unsafe APPLOAD and cleans VBus filesystem SHM by immutable identity.
dispositions.validation: Wide/sparse MADT, concurrent serial/TTY IRQ, APPLOAD denial and exec-failure cleanup.

dispositions.rationale: The canonical timer IRQ now publishes only atomic deferred work. Integrity hashing, pressure reclaim, callbacks and page-table work execute at a scheduler process-context safe point using the absolute timer clock.
dispositions.validation: Production monitor/drain extraction tests pass in UP and NATIVE_SMP_TEST with ASan/UBSan, including skipped telemetry period boundaries. Native build and BIOS/UEFI x 1/4-vCPU boot-to-userland pass on one ISO from fedcfc895b1cc499dcb183fa1978be25c996075d (docs/design/evidence/ai-monitor-coalescing-2026-09-18/). One observation per configuration, not performance acceptance. Still required: instrumented guest proof that deadlines fire, execution is bounded and no AI allocator/VMM/callback runs on the IRQ stack; safe cancellation and production SMP synchronization.

dispositions.rationale: No VMBus transport exists and the donor reports len as sent when no transmit hook is installed.
dispositions.validation: Require real Hyper-V channel offer/open/send/receive/close with timeout, error and host interoperability tests.

dispositions.rationale: The architecture ECAM implementation is already selected; the donor silently aligns offsets and accepts the first MCFG allocation regardless of segment.
dispositions.validation: Fix canonical segment selection/init synchronization and test multiple MCFG allocations before physical qualification.

dispositions.rationale: The donor ignores port and principal capabilities, permits all private/link-local/CGNAT destinations and is not connected to connect/sendto.
dispositions.validation: Design a deny-first per-principal policy and test socket entry points, ports, revocation, IPv4/IPv6 and lateral-movement negatives.

dispositions.rationale: These tests contain vacuous passes, copied structures, reimplemented algorithms or false zero-copy/latency claims and do not exercise production behavior.
dispositions.validation: Replace only with production-linked tests that contain negative controls and exact safety/performance assertions.

dispositions.rationale: The documents target old single-address-space PCID and password-session TPM formats, while canonical roots and salted HMAC sessions differ.
dispositions.validation: Use current KPTI/TLB and TPM protocol tests.

dispositions.rationale: The 100-cold-boot idea is valid, but the test depends on an unimplemented PCR read and therefore is not currently executable evidence.
dispositions.validation: Implement real TPM PCR read and run 100 independent cold boots on qualified hardware with a signed expected-event manifest.

current_code_findings: kernel/src/mm/ai_slots.c enables CR4.PCIDE without complete CPUID/ASID-lifecycle integration; audit before any PCID claim
kernel/src/boot/uefi_bridge.c advertises tagged no-flush switching but has no qualified ASID lifecycle or active call path
kernel/src/sec/mmr_audit.c has unsynchronized global peaks, scratch storage and leaf count; SMP append/finalize is unqualified
kernel/src/crypto/mlkem768.c still marks keygen, encapsulation and decapsulation as STUBBED
canonical ECAM still needs explicit segment selection and synchronized initialization
AHCI, authorized NPU MMIO, real Hyper-V transport and per-principal egress enforcement remain new implementation work
